acquired.note: installed from an installer the user downloaded from myabandonware.com (game page isle-wars-pro-ovz)

sets.notes: Set = every file of the install except the Inno Setup uninstaller pair, unins000.exe and unins000.dat, excluded because unins000.dat records the install itself and would make the id depend on the machine. The version 2.0 is the one Islepro.txt states (Islepro.txt:2); the projector's PE version resource (Macromedia Director Player 7.0.2r85) describes Director, not the game, and is not used as the game's version. Source: a third-party mirror (myabandonware.com), so the copy may differ from Soleau Software's own distribution. The sha256 of the downloaded installer file was not supplied and is not recorded here. runtime_writes is empty because nothing has been observed yet; W3a measures it and, if the runtime changes a listed file, registers a successor set. xtras/Isledft.dat and xtras/Islepro.dat are unconfirmed candidates for runtime writes (guessed from their names and sizes, not observed). Unregistered-build limit seen in the documents: the player plays Blue against three computer opponents (Islepro.txt:21-23 and :66-67); what registration unlocks beyond Islepro.txt:221-228 is unknown.
